name: app-check-admin-verify-token-content-checks
description: firebase-admin/app-check verifyToken pre-signature validation order and error contracts: synchronous throws for non-object options and non-string token, async rejection with app-check/invalid-credential when no projectId is configured, base64url decode rejection, and ordered content checks for alg, aud, iss, missing sub, non-string sub, and empty sub.

optionsNull.message: VerifyAppCheckTokenOptions must be a non-null object.

nonStringToken.message: App check token must be a non-null string.

missingProjectId.message: Must initialize app with a cert credential or set your Firebase project ID as the GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT environment variable to verify an App Check token.

invalidBase64UrlSegment.message: Decoding App Check token failed. Make sure you passed the entire string JWT which represents the Firebase App Check token.

wrongAlgorithm.message: The provided App Check token has incorrect algorithm. Expected "RS256" but got "HS256".

wrongAudience.message: The provided App Check token has incorrect "aud" (audience) claim. Expected "projects/another-project" but got "projects/123456789012,projects/demo-project". Make sure the App Check token comes from the same Firebase project as the service account used to authenticate this SDK.

wrongIssuer.message: The provided App Check token has incorrect "iss" (issuer) claim.

missingSub.message: The provided App Check token has no "sub" (subject) claim.

nonStringSub.message: The provided App Check token has no "sub" (subject) claim.

emptySub.message: The provided App Check token has an empty string "sub" (subject) claim.
